subject: Request: CloudForge cohort boost — promo voucher escrow & routing
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudforge.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: CloudForge cohort voucher request and escrow idea

Hi Connor / Vanessa,

Hope you’re both well — Launchpad asked CloudForge to sponsor a cohort of 30 early-stage startups for the accelerator that starts Aug 15. We talked about Redwood in the partner orientation and several founders asked for credits to run early experiments.

Quick ask: can Redwood reserve a block of promo vouchers we can distribute, but keep the funds in escrow until usage shows activity? CloudForge would like the vouchers tied to the marketplace so we can track activation. Attached: cloudforge_voucher_terms.pdf (terms) and cohort-list.csv (startup names + emails).

High-level ask: 30 vouchers, $3k each face value (total $90k), flexible to split as smaller tokens. Need confirmation by Tue Aug 4 to make Launchpad collateral. If escrow is too heavy, what alternatives do you recommend?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
sarah.kim@cloudforge.com
marketplace-support@cloudforge.com

Attachment: cloudforge_voucher_terms.pdf (pdf), cohort-list.csv (csv)

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CloudForge cohort voucher request and escrow idea

Vanessa — looping Ben and Evelyn so we can move quickly. Summary below, then my notes.

Original: CloudForge requests a 30-unit voucher pool (suggested $3k each; total $90k). They want vouchers attached to marketplace activation and held in escrow until usage is validated by activation logs. Deadline Aug 4.

My read / options:
- We can do a staged voucher allocation: seed pool of $30k (10 vouchers), with top-up upon activation metrics. That reduces immediate ledger exposure.
- Alternatively, we issue marketplace credits now but require CloudForge to accept a usage cap and 30-day activation check; if unused we reclaim or reassign.
- Escrow: Redwood legal prefers not to hold third-party funds; Finance can create a deferred revenue hold but would prefer marketplace voucher mechanics with conditional activation (preferred).

Ben — can you draft pricing/credit mechanics for a 30-voucher cohort with a 10-voucher initial release and criteria for top-up? Include how we’d track activation (HubSpot + Console events).
Evelyn — need an authorization path for $30k initial commit and guidance on wording for CloudForge terms (we’ll need to tweak the attached PDF).

If OK I’ll reply to Sarah outlining the staged approach and ask for the cohort activation window.

Thanks,
Connor Obrien
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CloudForge cohort voucher request and escrow idea

Connor / Vanessa — quick pricing suggestion.

Proposal:
- Initial marketplace credit issuance: $30,000 (10 vouchers @ $3k face).
- Conditional top-up: additional $60,000 released in two tranches (after 30 and 60 days) based on an activation threshold: >= 40% of initial vouchers activated OR 12 active startups, whichever comes first.
- Matching: Redwood contribution option — we can offer a 20% match (in product credits) if CloudForge promotes Redwood in Launchpad collateral (e.g., logo + 1 co-hosted office hours). That would make effective total $108k in credits.

Tracking: use voucher redemption events in Redwood Console + cohort list (cohort-list.csv). We’ll create a custom tag "cloudforge_launchpad_aug2026" and add HubSpot deal DF-76214.

Attachment: draft_terms_redwood_markup.pdf (I’ll send a version with redlines after Evelyn’s review).

If Finance signs off on the staged model we can confirm with Sarah today.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudforge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Priya Reddy <priya@launchpad.io>
Date: 2026-08-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CloudForge cohort voucher request and escrow idea

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We can support CloudForge for the Launchpad cohort with a staged voucher allocation that keeps the initial exposure limited and allows for top-ups based on activation. Proposed plan below: 

1) Initial issuance: 10 marketplace vouchers, $3k face each ($30k total).
2) Top-ups: two tranches, $30k at ~30 days and $30k at ~60 days subject to activation metrics (>=40% activation OR 12 active startups).
3) Match: Redwood will add 20% in product credits if CloudForge includes Redwood in Launchpad collateral and one co-hosted office hour (optional).
4) Mechanics: vouchers created in the Marketplace with tag "cloudforge_launchpad_aug2026". Redemption events tracked in Redwood Console and HubSpot deal DF-76214.
5) Escrow alternative: instead of Redwood holding funds, CloudForge can provide an escrow agreement externally and we’ll honor conditional top-ups on verified activation. Redwood legal prefers marketplace conditional release rather than holding external escrow.

Next steps: Ben will circulate updated T&Cs (redlines). Evelyn — would you and finance sign off on initial $30k commit and the conditional top-up wording? Sarah / Priya — please confirm the cohort activation window (we assume 60 days after launch) and whether the startups on cohort-list.csv are final.

Thanks — can do a 15-min sync if easier.

Best,
Connor Obrien
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

2) Top-up criteria: confirm the activation signal we’ll use (Console redemption event + email confirmation from CloudForge). Ben / Connor to add specific event names to the T&Cs.
3) Escrow: we will not hold third-party cash. If CloudForge insists on escrow, they must provide signed escrow instructions and legal will review; prefer marketplace conditional release.
4) Accounting tag: tag the spend to DF-76214 and include "cloudforge_launchpad_aug2026" in the transaction memo.

Ben — please attach the redlined terms file (I reviewed page 2 notes) and I’ll route this through Procurement for a $30k authorization. Once Procurement confirms, Connor can send the acceptance email to CloudForge and Priya. Also add the HubSpot link in the acceptance email.
